verdict.rationale: Lambda docs confirm you can select an alternative base image via the API and use cloud-init for launch-time customization, and Slurm clusters preinstall container runtimes like Podman/Apptainer/Enroot for custom containers. However, there is no explicit first-class 'bring your own Docker image' workflow (like a registry-based custom image upload) for standard On-Demand Cloud instances — customization is limited to base image swap + cloud-init scripts. Missing for 10: a documented custom Docker image upload/registry feature for ODC instances, clearer guidance on running arbitrary container images outside Slurm/K8s contexts, and independent user confirmation of successful custom-image workflows.
